title: Mayon volcano Alert Level 3 update — lava flows Basud 3.8km, SO2 2,184 t/d, 283 rockfalls (May 6)
snippet: PHIVOLCS reports Mayon at Alert Level 3 (Intensified Unrest): lava effusion + episodic minor strombolian. Lava flows at Basud (3.8 km), Bonga (3.2 km), Mi-isi (1.6 km) gullies. 11 VQ, 283 rockfalls, 17 PDC signals. SO2 2,184 tonnes/day. Moderate emissions, westward drift.
